h2: Eddy current inspection services for Portland: docked ships, fuel terminals and tube bundles
html:
Eddy current inspection services for Portland: docked ships, fuel terminals and tube bundles

In Portland, eddy current work centers on two places. One is ship repair on Swan Island, where docked vessels open up coolers, condensers and coated steel for inspection. The other is the fuel terminals and pipelines that supply Oregon. Atlantis, based in Houston, sends ET crews with probes chosen for each tube material and coating system, and quotes every scope from the asset list.

Swan Island dry-docking periods. Vigor's original shipyard is on Swan Island. Its three dry docks include The Vigorous, a 960-foot floating dock that Vigor described as the largest in North America when it arrived in 2014. A docking period is often the only time a vessel's seawater-cooled heat exchangers, condensers and lube oil coolers can be opened. Bobbin-probe eddy current screens copper-nickel and brass tubing for pitting, erosion and wall loss. Rotating or array probes then size the tubes that will be plugged. Ferromagnetic tubing goes to IRIS. On the hull and deck, weld-probe eddy current and ACFM check weld toes and brackets for cracking through the paint. That saves blasting and recoating areas that turn out to be sound.

Terminals and pipelines. Oregon receives most of its refined products from Washington refineries, through the Olympic Pipeline and by barge on the Columbia. Portland terminals then send product onward, including on Kinder Morgan's roughly 115-mile line to Eugene, which carries about 42,000 barrels a day. In those terminals, eddy current methods help in two places. Pulsed eddy current screens insulated piping and vessels for wall loss without stripping insulation, and the readings show where to open it for a closer look. Surface ET and ACFM check dock and loading-structure welds for fatigue cracks. Tank floors and shells are a separate scope and are covered on tank inspection in Portland.

Which state applies. Vigor also operates a smaller facility in Vancouver, Washington, and crews regularly work on both banks of the river. Pressure equipment on the Washington side is under the Department of Labor & Industries rules in chapter 296-104 WAC, and Oregon jobs follow Oregon's own requirements. The governing jurisdiction, code and acceptance criteria are named in the quotation, not left for the report.

  • Shipboard coolers and condensers: bobbin screening, rotating or array sizing
  • Ferrous tubes: IRIS instead of conventional eddy current
  • Coated hull and deck welds: crack detection without stripping paint
  • Insulated terminal piping and vessels: pulsed eddy current wall-loss screening

Routing. Searches for ECT inspection services in general are answered by the national eddy current testing page. Vessel work in the city is on marine NDT in Portland. Technician courses are on ET technician training, and probe handling can be rehearsed in the Practical NDT eddy current module. Send tube counts, materials and docking dates through the Portland ET enquiry.
